paragraph1: entretemps is an independent, artist-run gallery in the Hochelaga neighbourhood of Montreal.
paragraph2: Our mission is to provide a welcoming space for artists from all walks of life, and all stages of their career.
paragraph3: We want you to leave an Entretemps show feeling amazed and inspired, questioning reality, with a skip in your step and a smirk on your face. Above all, we believe that art should be FUN, the tangible fruits of human endeavour should be CELEBRATED and that all voices are VALUABLE.
